description: Seven real Sentinel-2 scenes with cloud masks, calibrated vegetation/water indices and georeferenced seasonal monitoring

issues.title: Validate field crop masks and observed agronomic conditions
issues.body: The demonstration includes a landscape footprint, not an identified crop parcel. Obtain rights-cleared crop masks and field observations before any crop-specific stress diagnosis or index-accuracy claim.

issues.title: Extend phenology comparison across independent years
issues.body: Current seven scenes cover April–October 2024. Predefine multi-year scene selection and assess missing-cloud periods and phenology variation without claiming yield or irrigation outcomes.
